name: OpenObserve Community Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 OpenObserve open-source edition for self-hosted logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts and OpenTelemetry ingestion; no vendor-hosted monthly ingestion allowance or software seat quota.
watch_out: Bring your own compute, storage and object storage; infrastructure costs and AGPL-3.0 network-source obligations apply. SSO, enterprise RBAC, audit trails and some security features require the paid Enterprise edition. This is NOT the discontinued OpenObserve Cloud free tier.
